key_insight: TopoFormer turns graph topology into short token sequences that a Transformer can learn from, combining topological structure with attention in a scalable way.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical graph-learning pipeline that is parallelizable, lightweight, and easy to plug into standard deep-learning workflows for classification and molecular prediction.
method: Topo-Scan slices node or edge filtrations into ordered topological tokens.
A Transformer encodes these sequences into graph-level embeddings.
The design avoids expensive persistent homology diagram computation while preserving multi-scale structure.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art results across graph classification and molecular property prediction benchmarks, outperforming or matching strong GNN and topology-based baselines.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how filtrations and token ordering are chosen, so implementation details could affect stability and downstream accuracy.
paper_title: TopoFormer: Topology Meets Attention for Graph Learning
